[LLOG.1.2] `Occupied` is asserted when the motion sensor reports `"on"`. It
stays asserted for as long as the sensor continues reporting
`"on"`. When the sensor's state changes (say, to `"off"`), the
LHS stops matching; the `Occupied` fact retracts automatically.
The rule's RHS does not run on the retract — retraction is a
maintenance operation, not a rule firing.
